business_description: AI-powered fundraising platform that helps founders find investors, contact them with personalised outreach, manage their investor pipeline and raise capital.
products: Investor database (14,900+ investors in 93 countries: angels, syndicates, pre-seed and seed VCs, CVCs, family offices)
Investor discovery: filters by sector, stage, cheque size, geography and who leads rounds; AI search in plain English; fit score with reasons
Investor lists by country, stage and sector (public /investors pages, aggregates only)
Personalised three-email outreach sequences sent from the founder's own Gmail
Auto-send in each investor's morning send window, or one by one with a quick preview and Send now
Spam risk check and domain check before scheduling; warm-up and daily sending limits
Follow-ups pause the moment an investor replies; bounces cancel later emails to that address
Bulk add investors to outreach from a list or shortlist
Investor CRM / fundraising tracker: nine stages from Not started to Payment received, notes, reminders, spreadsheet import
Personal AI fundraising agent (Raise Agent / Outreach Agent) and a daily brief of follow-ups due
Round and progress update emails to every investor already contacted
Data room pages with per-investor views, reading time and downloads
Free task manager for founders (To do / In progress / Done, sticky notes, top 3 on home)
Fundraising resources: pitch decks by stage, AI perks, YC applications, accelerators and VCs
target_audience: Founders raising angel, pre-seed and seed rounds; fractional CFOs and fundraising consultants
brand_voice: Direct, confident, founder-to-founder, practical, zero fluff; operator who has raised before

competitors.positioning: Angel investor matching network: founders list a pitch and investors browse it
Investor database, data room and investor outreach for founders
